**Short answer:**  
A countertop convection oven (e.g., Breville Smart Oven Pro, June Oven, or Anova Precision Oven) is the most versatile “machine” for baking a chocolate cake. It gives you precise temperature control, a built‑in timer, and a “cake” preset that does the trick without any extra steps.

---

### Why a countertop convection oven?

| Feature | Why it matters for cake |
|---------|------------------------|
| **Convection fan** | Even heat distribution → no hot spots, even rise and browning. |
| **Temperature accuracy** | Keeps the oven at the exact 350 °F (175 °C) needed for most cakes. |
| **Cake preset** | Pre‑programmed bake time and temperature for a standard 9‑inch cake. |
| **Timer & alerts** | Stops the oven automatically when the cake is done, preventing over‑baking. |
| **Compact size** | Fits on a countertop, no need for a full‑size oven. |
| **Smart connectivity** | Some models (June, Anova) can be controlled via app, giving you remote monitoring. |

---

### Other good options

| Appliance | Best for | Pros | Cons |
|-----------|----------|------|------|
| **Standard electric oven** | If you already have one | No extra purchase | Requires manual timing and temperature checks |
| **Bread machine with cake setting** | Small batches | Easy to use, automatic mixing | Limited to small pans, may not brown well |
| **Microwave oven with cake setting** | Quick, small cakes | Fast, no pre‑heat | Often produces uneven texture |
| **Toaster oven** | Small cakes or cupcakes | Compact, quick pre‑heat | Limited temperature range, may not brown evenly |
| **Smart oven (June, Anova)** | Tech‑savvy users | Remote control, precise monitoring | Higher price point |

---

### Quick recommendation

If you’re looking for a single machine that will reliably bake a chocolate cake (and many other baked goods) with minimal effort, go with a **countertop convection oven**. The Breville Smart Oven Pro is a popular choice for its reliability and affordability, while the June Oven or Anova Precision Oven offer advanced smart features if you want to get more tech‑savvy.

Happy baking!
